answers.core:
If my assumption is correct, and the change required is only a single if and not much more. This should be a small, yet helpful addition to already existing system present in the core.
Making it an add-on or an asset wouldn't therefore make sense.
answers.workaround:
Yes, the same effect can be achieved with the work around of having nodes set like so:

```py
World (ysort enabled)
    Player
        PlayerSorter (ysort enabled)  # This is an empty 2D node
            Body
            Shield
    Map (ysort enabled)
        Rock1
        Rock2
```

title: Option to break the chain of YSorting
